name: Remina
source:
"This weird girl came up to me and says she loves me, but I don't think I've ever seen her before?"

All she says is that she’s been watching you for a long time, learning everything about you. She’s built her entire world around you, and now, she’s finally ready to reveal herself. Or rather… to let you see what she’s always known: You belong to her.

[From [url=https://hereisremina.itch.io/crush]the itch.io gamepage[/url]]
